$Comment: Thunderhead, the Lightning Focus's signature: a Lightning hit (where the Lightning damage line counts) staggers its foe and every other foe within 2.5 blocks of it for half a second (CommonLib's Zig_Staggered, a Stun to a boss's rules, so a boss or an elite shrugs it), at most once every 10 seconds. Its stagger waits per foe like every control: an Immune foe is passed over, it is shorter each time on a foe staggered again soon, and each landing ramps the foe's Immunity. Opens on the Signature step while the Lightning Focus is sworn. Retune or switch it off in mods/ziggfreedcommon/procs.json.
